exercises.name: Assisted pistol squat
exercises.setup: Hold a post, doorframe or band in front of you; one leg out in front.
cues: Use the support only as much as you need
Sit down slowly on the working leg
Knee tracks over the toes
Drive up through the whole foot

exercises.name: Australian row
exercises.setup: Bar set low in the rack; lie under it with heels on the floor and body straight.
cues: Body in one line from heels to shoulders
Pull the chest to the bar
Squeeze the shoulder blades at the top
Lower the bar height to make it harder

exercises.name: Band face pull
exercises.setup: Band anchored at face height, hands at the ends, step back until there is tension.
cues: Pull toward your forehead, hands apart
Elbows high, finishing with a double-biceps shape
Squeeze the upper back at the end
Control the band back out

exercises.name: Band lat pulldown
exercises.setup: Band anchored high, kneel or sit facing it, arms up.
cues: Pull the elbows down to your sides
Chest up toward the hands
Squeeze the lats for a second
Let the arms go fully up between reps

exercises.name: Band lateral raise
exercises.setup: Stand on the middle of the band, one end in each hand (or one side at a time).
cues: Lead with the elbows out to the sides
Raise to shoulder height and pause
Keep tension at the bottom: don't let the band go slack
Lower slowly against the band

exercises.name: Band overhead extension
exercises.setup: Band under the back foot or anchored low behind you; hands overhead.
cues: Elbows by the ears, pointed forward
Lower the hands behind the head into a stretch
Extend to straight arms
Control the band back down

exercises.name: Band seated row
exercises.setup: Sit with legs extended, band around the feet.
cues: Sit tall, chest up
Pull the hands to the lower ribs
Squeeze the shoulder blades
Return slowly with tension

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.setup: Bar on the upper back, hands just outside the shoulders, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
cues: Big breath and brace before you unrack and before every rep
Knees track over the toes as you sit down between the hips
Depth: hip crease at or below the knee, chest up
Drive up through the whole foot, hips and chest rising together

exercises.name: Barbell push press
exercises.setup: Bar on the front of the shoulders from the rack, grip just outside the shoulders.
cues: Short, straight dip, heels down
Explode up with the legs, then press
Head through at lockout
Catch the bar back on the shoulders softly

exercises.name: Barbell row
exercises.setup: Hinge to about 45° with a flat back, bar hanging at the knees, overhand grip just outside the legs.
cues: Brace and keep the torso still
Pull the bar to the lower ribs
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top
Lower until the arms are straight

exercises.name: Barbell shrug
exercises.setup: Bar at arm's length, hands just outside the thighs.
cues: Shrug straight up toward the ears
Hold a one-second squeeze at the top
No rolling the shoulders
Lower all the way down

exercises.name: Behind-the-back shrug
exercises.setup: Barbell held behind you at arm's length, hands just outside the hips.
cues: Lean forward a touch to clear the glutes
Shrug up and slightly back
Squeeze for a second at the top
Lower slowly

exercises.name: Box pistol squat
exercises.setup: A box or bench behind you; stand on one leg with the other leg out in front.
cues: Arms forward for balance
Sit back slowly to the box on one leg
Touch, don't flop
Stand up on the working leg; lower the box over time

exercises.name: Brisk outdoor walk
exercises.setup: Comfortable shoes, outside.
cues: 20–30 minutes at a brisk pace
Conversational effort
Tall posture, arms swinging
Log done = 1

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.setup: Back foot on a bench, front foot far enough forward that the knee stays over the foot. Dumbbells at your sides.
cues: Lower straight down until the back knee nearly touches the floor
Front knee tracks over the toes
Slight forward lean is fine; keep the chest proud
Drive up through the front heel; all reps on one leg, then switch

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.setup: Clear floor space; start standing.
cues: Hands down, jump the feet back to a plank
Chest to the floor, then up
Jump the feet in and jump up
Steady pace for the whole interval

exercises.name: Cable face pull
exercises.setup: Rope at upper-chest to eye height, thumbs toward you, one step back.
cues: Pull the rope toward your face, splitting the ends apart
Finish with the elbows high and the hands beside the ears
Squeeze the upper back for a second
Return slowly; don't let the stack pull you forward

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise drop set
exercises.setup: Low cable, handle in the far hand, standing side-on to the stack.
cues: 12 reps, drop the weight one or two plates, 12 more with no rest
Lead with the elbow out to the side, up to shoulder height
Slight lean away from the stack for tension at the bottom
Same slow lowering on both halves of the drop set

exercises.name: Cable woodchop
exercises.setup: Cable at shoulder height, stand side-on, both hands on the handle.
cues: Rotate through the hips and torso, not just the arms
Arms stay long
Finish across the body at hip height
Return slowly; 12 per side

exercises.name: Calorie row
exercises.setup: Rower monitor on calories, feet strapped at the widest part of the foot.
cues: Legs, then body, then arms on the drive
Arms, then body, then legs on the way back
Push hard with the legs; the arms just finish
Keep the damper around 5–7

exercises.name: Chest-to-bar pull-up
exercises.setup: Hang from the bar, hands just wider than the shoulders.
cues: Pull until the chest touches the bar
Drive the elbows down and back
Lean back slightly at the top
Lower under control to a full hang

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.setup: Hands shoulder-width, palms facing you.
cues: Start from a dead hang
Pull the elbows down to the ribs
Chin over the bar without craning the neck
Lower all the way under control

exercises.name: Conventional deadlift
exercises.setup: Bar over the middle of the foot, hip-width stance, hands just outside the shins.
cues: Push the hips back to grip; shins touch the bar
Pull the slack out of the bar and brace hard
Push the floor away; bar stays against the legs
Lock out with the glutes, then lower the same path

exercises.name: Counterweight pistol squat
exercises.setup: Hold a light plate or dumbbell out in front at chest height.
cues: The weight helps you balance: hold it out as you sit
Lower slowly to full depth on one leg
Free leg stays off the floor
Stand up without bouncing

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.setup: On your back, arms up, knees bent at 90° over the hips.
cues: Press the low back into the floor
Reach the opposite arm and leg away slowly
Exhale as you reach
Return and switch sides; 6 per side

exercises.name: Dead hang
exercises.setup: Hang from the bar with a full grip, shoulder-width.
cues: Arms straight, body still
Shoulders gently pulled down, not shrugged to the ears
Breathe steadily
Scap pulls: lift the body a little using only the shoulder blades

exercises.name: Deficit push-ups
exercises.setup: Hands on two dumbbells or plates so the chest can go below hand height; body in one line.
cues: Brace: glutes and abs tight, hips level
Lower the chest between the hands with elbows about 45°
Pause just below hand level
Push the floor away to straight arms

exercises.name: Diamond push-up
exercises.setup: Hands together under the chest, thumbs and index fingers in a diamond.
cues: Elbows close to the ribs
Chest to the hands
Body stays straight
As many good reps as you can

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.setup: Parallel bars, arms locked out, chest up, legs crossed or straight below you.
cues: Lower until the shoulders are just below the elbows, or as deep as is comfortable
Lean slightly forward and keep the elbows tracking back
Press up to locked arms
Max reps, stopping 1–2 short of failure; 12 counts as top of range

exercises.name: Dragon flag or leg raise
exercises.setup: Lie on a bench and hold it behind the head.
cues: Body straight from the shoulders to the toes
Lower slowly as one piece
Bend the knees or do leg raises to make it easier
Stop before the low back arches

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.setup: On a flat bench, dumbbells over the chest, feet flat.
cues: Shoulder blades pinned back
Lower for 2 s and pause for 1 s at the chest
Elbows about 45° from the body
Press up and slightly together

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.setup: Stand tall, dumbbells at the sides, palms forward.
cues: Elbows pinned to the sides
Curl up and squeeze
Lower slowly to straight arms
No swinging

exercises.name: Dumbbell push press
exercises.setup: Dumbbells at the shoulders, feet hip-width.
cues: Short dip at the knees, torso upright
Drive up with the legs and press
Lock out with the biceps by the ears
Lower back to the shoulders under control

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.setup: A dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs.
cues: Soft knees, hips push straight back
Dumbbells stay close to the legs
Flat back; stop at a strong hamstring stretch
Glutes drive you back to standing

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrug
exercises.setup: A dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
cues: Shrug straight up
One-second hold at the top
Arms stay straight; no curling
Full lowering between reps

exercises.name: Dumbbell skull crusher
exercises.setup: On a bench, dumbbells straight up over the shoulders, palms facing.
cues: Elbows point up and stay still
Lower beside the head slowly
Extend back to straight arms
Keep the upper arms vertical

exercises.name: Dumbbell standing press
exercises.setup: Dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing in or slightly forward, feet hip-width.
cues: Brace and squeeze glutes so the ribs stay down
Press up and slightly in until the arms are straight
Keep the wrists stacked over the elbows
Lower to ear level with control

exercises.name: Easy rower 20 min
exercises.setup: Rower damper 4–6.
cues: 20 minutes at a pace you can talk at
Smooth, relaxed strokes
Breathe through the nose if you can
Log done = 1

exercises.name: Easy rower or incline treadmill walk
exercises.setup: Rower or a brisk incline walk.
cues: 20–30 minutes, conversational pace
You should be able to talk the whole time
This is recovery, not a test
Log done = 1

exercises.name: Farmer carry
exercises.setup: Heavy dumbbells at your sides; clear space for 40 m.
cues: Stand tall, shoulders back and down
Short, quick steps
Grip hard and keep the weights from swinging
40 m per set; it counts as done = 1

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.setup: Bar on the front of the shoulders in a rack, elbows high, feet shoulder-width.
cues: Elbows up the whole rep so the bar stays on the shoulders
Sit straight down between the heels
Chest tall; knees track over the toes
Drive up leading with the elbows

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.setup: Hold one dumbbell vertically at the chest, elbows under it, feet shoulder-width.
cues: Sit down between the hips, elbows inside the knees
Chest tall, the weight stays touching the body
Full depth you can control
Stand by driving the floor away

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.setup: Dumbbells at your sides, palms facing each other.
cues: Elbows pinned to your sides
Curl up with the palms staying in
No swinging the torso
Lower slowly to straight arms

exercises.name: Wall handstand hold
exercises.setup: Hands a hand-width from a wall; kick up or walk the feet up the wall.
cues: Push the floor away, arms locked
Ribs in, body in a straight line
Look between the hands
Come down before the form fades

exercises.name: Hanging knee or leg raise
exercises.setup: Hang from the bar with straight arms, shoulders active.
cues: Curl the pelvis up, not just the legs
Knees (or straight legs) to hip height or higher
No swinging: pause at the bottom
Lower slowly

exercises.name: Heavy farmer hold
exercises.setup: Heavier than your carry; stand in place.
cues: Tall posture, shoulders down
Squeeze the handles as hard as you can
Breathe and brace for 30 seconds
Set the weights down under control

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.setup: On your back, arms overhead, legs straight.
cues: Low back pressed into the floor
Lift the shoulders and legs a few inches
Bend the knees or bring the arms in to make it easier
Breathe without losing the low back

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.setup: Bench at about 45–60°, arms hanging straight down behind the body.
cues: Keep the upper arms still and back
Curl up, turning the palms up
Squeeze at the top without the elbows coming forward
Lower to a full stretch

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.setup: Bench at about 30°. Kick the dumbbells up from your knees; feet planted.
cues: Shoulder blades pulled back and down into the bench
Lower to the upper chest with elbows about 45° from the body
Press up and slightly together without clanking the bells
Stop each rep 1–2 short of failure

exercises.name: Jump rope
exercises.setup: Rope handles at hip height; clear space overhead.
cues: Small hops on the balls of the feet
Turn the rope with the wrists, not the arms
Elbows close to the sides
Steady rhythm for the interval

exercises.name: Jump rope or burpee intervals
exercises.setup: Rope or open floor space.
cues: 10 rounds: 20 s hard, 40 s rest
Jump rope: light, quick bounces
Burpees: chest to the floor, jump at the top
Log done = 1

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.setup: Bell a foot in front of you, feet just wider than the hips.
cues: Hike the bell back between the legs
Snap the hips forward; the arms just guide
Stand tall and squeeze the glutes at the top
Flat back the whole time

exercises.name: L-sit hold
exercises.setup: Parallettes, dip bars or the floor; straight arms.
cues: Push the floor away, shoulders down
Both legs straight and level with the hips
Point the toes and squeeze the thighs
Hold 15–30 s; log done

exercises.name: Lateral raise
exercises.setup: Light dumbbells or a low cable, slight bend in the elbows, a small lean forward.
cues: Lead with the elbows, out to the sides
Raise to shoulder height, not higher
Pinkies level with or slightly above the thumbs
Lower slowly; no swinging

exercises.name: Lateral raise light
exercises.setup: Lighter than your main lateral raise: this one is for high reps and a strong pump.
cues: Slight lean forward, soft elbows
Raise out to shoulder height, leading with the elbows
Keep the traps quiet: shoulders down, away from the ears
Smooth 2-second lowering on every rep

exercises.name: Lying leg raise
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, hands under the hips or holding a bench behind you.
cues: Press the lower back into the floor
Raise straight legs to vertical
Lower slowly, stopping before the back arches
Breathe out as the legs rise

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.setup: High plank, hands under the shoulders.
cues: Hips level with the shoulders
Drive the knees to the chest, fast
Keep the hands planted
Steady breathing for the full 30 s

exercises.name: Nordic curl negative or weighted glute bridge
exercises.setup: Nordic: kneel with heels anchored under a bench or couch. Bridge: back on a bench, dumbbell on the hips.
cues: Nordic: lower the body as slowly as you can, hips straight
Catch yourself with the hands and push back up
Bridge: drive through the heels and squeeze the glutes at the top
Ribs down; no arching the low back

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.setup: One hand and knee on a bench, the other foot on the floor; flat back.
cues: Pull the dumbbell toward the hip
Elbow stays close to the body
Squeeze the back at the top; no twisting
Full stretch at the bottom

exercises.name: One-leg L-sit hold
exercises.setup: Same support as the tuck L-sit.
cues: Push down, shoulders away from the ears
One leg straight out in front, the other tucked
Switch legs each set
Hold 15–30 s; log done

exercises.name: Overhead cable triceps extension
exercises.setup: Rope on a low or mid cable, face away, split stance, elbows up by the head.
cues: Keep the elbows pointed forward and still
Stretch the rope behind the head
Extend to straight arms, spreading the rope at the top
Slow lowering into the stretch

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.setup: Band anchored at chest height to your side; stand side-on, hands at the chest.
cues: Press the hands straight out and hold
Do not let the band twist you
Ribs down, glutes tight
30 s each side

exercises.name: Paused back squat
exercises.setup: Same setup as your back squat, a little lighter.
cues: Squat to depth and hold a full 2-second pause
Stay tight in the pause: no relaxing at the bottom
Drive up out of the pause without bouncing
Keep the chest up as you stand

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.setup: Hips high in an inverted V, hands shoulder-width.
cues: Lower the head toward the hands, between them
Elbows track back, not flared
Press back up through the shoulders
Raise the feet on a box to make it harder

exercises.name: Pistol squat progression
exercises.setup: Full pistol: stand on one leg, the other leg straight out in front.
cues: Arms forward, sit down slowly
Heel stays down, knee over the toes
Full depth, free leg off the floor
Stand up smoothly; 5 per leg

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.setup: Forearms under the shoulders, body straight from head to heels.
cues: Squeeze the glutes and brace the abs
Do not let the hips sag or pike
Push the floor away with the forearms
Breathe behind the brace

exercises.name: Pseudo planche or archer push-up
exercises.setup: Pseudo planche: hands by the hips, fingers turned out. Archer: wide hands, shift to one side.
cues: Lean the shoulders forward past the hands (pseudo planche)
Or shift the weight to one arm, other arm straight (archer)
Body stays in one line
Slow lowering

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.setup: Hang from the bar, hands slightly wider than the shoulders, palms away.
cues: Start each rep from a dead hang
Pull the elbows down toward the ribs
Chin clearly over the bar
Lower all the way under control; add weight once 10+ strict reps

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.setup: Hands just wider than the shoulders, body straight.
cues: Elbows about 45° from the body
Chest to a fist-height from the floor
Glutes and abs tight; no sagging
Lock out at the top

exercises.name: Rear-delt dumbbell fly
exercises.setup: Hinge forward with a flat back (or chest on an incline bench), light dumbbells hanging.
cues: Soft elbows, fixed angle
Raise the arms out to the sides, thinking "wide"
Squeeze the back of the shoulders at the top
Lower slowly; keep the traps out of it

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.setup: Barbell from the rack or floor, hip-width stance, hands just outside the thighs.
cues: Soft knees, then push the hips back
Bar slides down the thighs; keep it close
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch with a flat back
Squeeze the glutes to stand tall

exercises.name: Rower 5 × 500 m
exercises.setup: Rower damper 4–6. Warm up 5 minutes easy.
cues: 5 × 500 m at a strong, steady pace with 2 minutes easy between
Drive with the legs first
Long, smooth strokes around 24–28 per minute
Log done = 1

exercises.name: Rower intervals 8 × 250 m
exercises.setup: Rower damper 4–6. Warm up 5 minutes easy.
cues: 8 × 250 m hard with 1 minute easy between
Legs, then body, then arms on the drive
Arms, body, then legs on the way back
Even split times; log done = 1

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.setup: Sit tall, slight bend in the knees, handle at arm's length.
cues: Chest up; no rocking back
Pull to the lower ribs, elbows close
Squeeze the shoulder blades together
Reach forward slowly into a stretch

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell press
exercises.setup: Bench upright, dumbbells at shoulder height, back against the pad.
cues: Ribs down, no big arch
Press up and slightly in
Stop just short of the bells touching
Lower to ear level under control

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.setup: On one forearm, elbow under the shoulder, feet stacked.
cues: Hips up in a straight line
Do not let the top shoulder roll forward
Squeeze the glutes
Hold each side

exercises.name: Standing barbell overhead press
exercises.setup: Bar in the rack at collarbone height; hands just outside the shoulders, elbows slightly in front of the bar.
cues: Squeeze glutes and brace before every rep
Press straight up and move your head back, then through once the bar passes your forehead
Finish with the bar over the middle of your foot, biceps by your ears
Lower under control to the collarbones

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.setup: Balls of the feet on a step or plate, heels hanging off; hold a dumbbell or a support.
cues: Lower the heels into a deep stretch
Rise as high as you can onto the big toe
Pause a second at the top
No bouncing: slow down, slow up

exercises.name: Towel pull-up hang
exercises.setup: Two towels over the bar, one in each hand.
cues: Hang with active shoulders, not slumped
Crush the towels
Hold as long as you can with good position
Step down; don't drop

exercises.name: Treadmill hill sprints 10 × 20 s
exercises.setup: Treadmill at an incline you can sprint on; warm up 5 minutes.
cues: 10 × 20 s fast with about 60–90 s walking between
Drive the knees and arms
Step to the side rails between efforts
Log done = 1

exercises.name: Tuck L-sit hold
exercises.setup: Hands on parallettes, dip bars or the floor beside the hips.
cues: Push down hard and lift the hips
Knees tucked to the chest, feet off the floor
Shoulders down, away from the ears
Hold 15–30 s; log done

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.setup: Dumbbells at your sides, tall posture.
cues: Long step forward, lower the back knee toward the floor
Front knee over the foot
Push through the front heel to bring the back leg through
10 steps per leg; count each leg

exercises.name: Weighted pull-up
exercises.setup: Dip belt or a dumbbell between the feet; hands slightly wider than the shoulders.
cues: Start from a dead hang every rep
Squeeze the weight so it does not swing
Chin clearly over the bar
Add load once 10+ strict reps are easy

exercises.name: Weighted push-up
exercises.setup: Vest on, or a partner places a plate or dumbbell high on the back.
cues: Same line as a strict push-up
Keep the load over the shoulder blades
Full range every rep
Drop the load before form breaks

exercises.name: Weighted sit-up
exercises.setup: On your back, knees bent, a dumbbell or plate held at the chest.
cues: Feet anchored or flat
Curl up through the spine
Lower slowly
Keep the weight close to the chest

exercises.name: X3 bar calf raise
exercises.setup: Stand on the band, bar at the shoulders as in a squat.
cues: Rise as high as possible on the toes
Pause at the top
Lower slowly to a full stretch
One set to full failure, 15–40 reps

exercises.name: X3 bar chest press
exercises.setup: Band behind the back, bar at chest height, staggered stance.
cues: Press straight forward to locked arms
Shoulders down and back
Slow return to the chest
One set to full failure, 15–40 reps

exercises.name: X3 bar curl
exercises.setup: Stand on the band, bar in an underhand grip at the thighs.
cues: Elbows pinned to the sides
Curl to the shoulders and squeeze
No swinging from the hips
One set to full failure, 15–40 reps

exercises.name: X3 bar deadlift
exercises.setup: Stand on the band, bar at mid-shin, hip-width stance.
cues: Hinge back with a flat back to reach the bar
Brace, then stand up by pushing the floor away
Squeeze the glutes hard at the top, where it's heaviest
Control the lowering

exercises.name: X3 bar front raise
exercises.setup: Stand on the band, bar at the thighs, overhand grip.
cues: Arms nearly straight
Raise to eye level
No swinging from the hips
One set to full failure, 15–40 reps

exercises.name: X3 bar overhead press
exercises.setup: Stand on the band, bar at the shoulders.
cues: Brace the abs and squeeze the glutes
Press straight up, head through at the top
No leaning back
One set to full failure, 15–40 reps

exercises.name: X3 bar squat
exercises.setup: Stand on the band, bar across the front of the shoulders or held at the chest.
cues: Brace and sit down between the hips
Knees out over the toes
Drive up hard: the band gets heavier at the top
Pause briefly at the bottom to keep reps honest

exercises.name: X3 bar triceps extension
exercises.setup: Band anchored behind you under the feet, bar behind the head.
cues: Elbows point up and stay still
Extend to straight arms overhead
Slow lowering behind the head
One set to full failure, 15–40 reps
